name: ea-plays
description: The 'with the kit' layer for the Knowledge Product AI plays on government enterprise architecture and on the government interoperability framework: builds sourced country context (Play 0 and the interoperability supplement), verifies every claim against tiered public sources (cite-or-discard), checks which shared building blocks are actually live, maps public bodies and national law, finds comparator-country evidence with primary sources, grounds the enterprise architecture artefacts of Modules 2-5 in PAERA v1.0, and for the interoperability course drafts the decree against published legal models, the semantic map and OpenAPI contract against fetched vocabularies and specifications, and the X-Road registration, run book and once-only acceptance against the NIIS guides. Plays run bare in any assistant; this kit adds the sources and the verification.
